newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Japan to see 1.4-1.6 pct growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Japan to see 1.4-1.6 pct growth in 1997.

text.p: Japan is likely to see a year of slow Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth in the range of 1.4 to 1.7 percent in 1997, the Pacific Economic Cooperation Council (PECC) said on Tuesday.
"Business fixed investment and exports are likely to be the leading items among the components of GDP," PECC said in its annual economic forecast.
"In addition it is likely the (ruling) LDP will give in to strong pressure from the other aligned parties and postpone some of the planned fiscal tightening measures," the think-tank added.

"Taking all of these factors together, 1997 is likely to be a year of slow growth in the range of 1.4 to 1.6 percent. It is unlikely, however, that Japan will experience another recession," PECC added.
PECC is an independent, policy-oriented organisation of business, academic and government representatives from 22 Asia-Pacific economies.
